emma_cs: Heads up — NovaMed (acct 6612) invoice #8122 autopay failed 3x. Customer says treasury will wire today. Can we pause card retries and provide wire details?

luke_fin: share decline reasons + last4 pls. If wire is confirmed, mark payment_method=wire and disable retries.

emma_cs: last4 3010. Declines: `card_declined`, `insufficient_funds`, `do_not_honor`. Attempts at 2026-03-23T14:12Z, 14:36Z, 15:01Z. No AVS issues.

billing-bot: Payment log: invoice=8122 attempts=3 status=failed gateway=Stripe region=us-east-1

karen_billing: Agree with wire. I'll create a manual invoice flagged for wire and waive one late fee. Need written confirmation from customer that treasury will initiate wire and the exact reference they will include. Also require PO# if available.

ben_sales: Sales confirms PO-9911 exists. Treasury contact copied on the customer email. They asked for beneficiary + reference and said EOD wire.

emma_cs: Customer msg: "We'll wire by EOD. Please send beneficiary and exact reference: Invoice 8122 / PO-9911. Disable card retries."

luke_fin: Proceed. Action items: karen_billing create manual invoice, set payment_method=wire, disable card auto-retries. Emma attach customer confirmation to ticket. Once SWIFT/MT103 received, attach and reconcile.

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-4682 created for invoice 8122 manual-wire settlement.

emma_cs: Sending wire template via secure channel. Wire template (redacted for public):
Bank: Example Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account details: provided over secure channel
SWIFT: EXMPUS33
Reference: Invoice 8122 / PO-9911
Note: Please include exact reference to avoid delays.

karen_billing: Thanks. I'll monitor and update ticket. If we don't have proof by EOD PST, escalate to finance lead.

emma_cs: Will update when SWIFT copy arrives. Thanks all.
